transformer_v4_results.display_name: Transformer V4 — primary release model (z-v2 high-z ceiling fix, supersedes V3)
transformer_v4_results.eval: DR1 healpix-holdout val, blind-z (full spectrum, z hidden) + z-hidden 50%-masked recon, N=965970
transformer_v4_results.note: z-v2 tokenizer (gaussian_range 4.0) lifts the QSO high-z wall from z~2.13 to z~4.4; predicted high-z QSO fraction now matches truth to ~1%. No BGS/LRG regression vs V3. Decoupled-masking A/B (abmask_dec_zv2) tested and REJECTED (~20x worse blind-z at 50k) — V4 keeps independent masks. See RESEARCH_LOG 2026-06-29.

approach_a_results.display_name: Approach A — primary release model (v9, redshift conditioning dropout)
approach_a_results.note: Honest redshift-from-spectrum (z hidden from encoder at eval): 52% exact / 47% AR / 73% within-2-bins, still climbing toward the 150k-step cap. val_redshift_acc here is the genuine number (z hidden); zgiven=1.0 is the copy-path ceiling. Re-run scripts/sync_wandb_metrics.py when the run finalizes. Quote val_masked_spec_acc (~0.47) as the honest spectrum number.
